criteria.rationale: Verified the 16 inventory explanations against code, including MCP arguments extracted as one RawMessage by callToolCtx. Broader validation is reused sealed evidence rather than a new full-suite execution. D2 explicitly accepts human review of inventory explanations; no unresolved material assumption remains for this change.
The helper creates a local decoder over supplied bytes. No shared state, goroutine, cancellation or lifecycle mechanism is introduced.
Valid input contracts remain unchanged; rejecting trailing content is the specified correction. Positive controls and negative consumer regressions pass.
The helper rejects unknown fields, malformed input and trailing values or garbage. Consumers return errors before recording evidence, fulfilling requests or running hooks.
Verified production wiring through release record, action fulfil and hookRunner. The registered integration command independently passed.
Trailing-content errors are bounded and do not echo the trailing payload. Hook errors retain the policy path; action fulfil preserves its existing envelope diagnostic.

Examined the three decoder replacements and existing validation paths. Valid JSON and surrounding whitespace retain their behavior; malformed suffixes are intentionally rejected. CLI flags, schemas and MCP contracts are unchanged.

Independently reran the exact registered focused command successfully. The first decode validates the value and the subsequent Token call must return EOF, rejecting both additional values and malformed suffixes.

D1 centralizes the missing end check in DecodeStrictJSON and routes the three affected readers through it. D2 removes the unsound syntactic inference and makes R2 an explicit inventory obligation. Checked the helper, inventory and production composition against those decisions. No structural delta facts were enumerated in the brief.
The current R2 wording, D2, known-gap statement, guard comments and matrix command describe the implemented inventory design. No user-facing command or scaffold change is required.
Reviewed refusal diagnostics and exit paths. Users receive a trailing-content or invalid-envelope error before effects; removing the suffix produces the existing valid-input behavior.

R1 is covered by helper negatives and all three consumer regressions, with code inspection confirming effects occur after validation. R2 is covered by the passing source inventory guard and independent inspection of every exception.

The implementation is limited to the shared decoder, three consumers, regression coverage and permanent validation registration. Existing strict readers and the deliberately permissive review-policy reader retain their behavior.

Malformed evidence, envelopes and hook policies are rejected before authority-bearing effects. Existing path confinement and downstream authorization remain intact. No dependencies, credentials or new execution capability are introduced.

Compared the helper and reviewed inventory with three duplicated fixes and a semantic source analyzer. The chosen design is small and avoids speculative analysis machinery. Adding an arbitrary inventory explanation is the cheapest formal bypass; D2 explicitly assigns its truth to review, and all current entries were checked. This choice would need revisiting if automatic proof of exception semantics became a requirement.
